newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs fall on weak yen, undertone still bullish.
newsitem.headline: JGBs fall on weak yen, undertone still bullish.

text.p: Cash and futures JGBs fell on the weak yen in early trading on Monday, but traders said the undertone remained bullish, supported by persistent investor demand.
The key September was at 125.77, down from Friday's 125.92. Sporadic selling by traders set in as an early attempt to bring it up failed, traders said.

The dollar was quoted at 117.30/35 at 0111 GMT, up from Friday's 116.82/92 in New York. Market is waiting for industrial output data on Wednesday, particularly the outlook for July/August, for the next trading cue.
